src = src.replace("  extern __shared__ uint8_t smem_raw[];\n  __shared__ __align__(8) uint64_t full[kMaxStages], empty[kMaxStages], accum;\n  __shared__ uint32_t tmem_slot;\n  const uint32_t sbase = (smem_u32(smem_raw) + 1023) & ~1023u;\n  const int eb1",

src += r'''
extern "C" int dbg_get(unsigned long long* h){ return (int)cudaMemcpyFromSymbol(h, g_dbg, sizeof(unsigned long long)*600*8); }

'''
assert src.count("gt()") >= 8, src.count("gt()")

lib = ctypes.CDLL('/tmp/r7/dbg.so'); f = lib.adamod_tc_h_cfg
f.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]*5 + [ctypes.c_int]*4 + [ctypes.c_void_p]
import numpy as np
W = (torch.randn(18432,3072,device='cuda')/3072**0.5); bias = torch.randn(18432,device='cuda')

for B in [192, 384, 512, 691, 919]:

  for it in range(3):

    f(emb.data_ptr(), W.data_ptr(), bias.data_ptr(), ctypes.addressof(arr), e16.data_ptr(), B, 3, 3, 0, torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
    torch.cuda.synchronize(); lib.dbg_get(h)
  a = np.array(h, dtype=np.float64).reshape(600,8)
  t0 = a[590,0]; pe = a[591,0]-t0
  n = 288 if B > 512 else 144
  d = a[:n,:6]-t0
  def mm(x): return f"{x.min()/1e3:6.2f}-{x.max()/1e3:6.2f}"
  print(f"B={B} prepass end {pe/1e3:.2f}us | start {mm(d[:,0])} | prol {mm(d[:,1])} | kb0 {mm(d[::2,2])} | kb24 {mm(d[::2,3])} | accum {mm(d[:,4])} | end {mm(d[:,5])}")
  if n == 288:
    w2 = d[:,0] > d[:,0].min() + 10000
    print("   wave2 CTAs", w2.sum(), "start", mm(d[w2,0]), "accum", mm(d[w2,4]), "end", mm(d[w2,5]))
  ml = (d[::2,4]-d[::2,2]); print(f"   mainloop per CTA pair us {ml.min()/1e3:.2f}-{ml.max()/1e3:.2f} = ns/kb {np.median(ml)/48:.0f}; epi us {np.median(d[:,5]-d[:,4])/1e3:.2f}; kb0 lat after prol {np.median(d[::2,2]-d[::2,1])/1e3:.2f}")
